goal: Align the Tarot ask and draw screens with the approved Artifact design (gold selected states instead of pink, pill CTA in sentence case, no leftover old-version controls), fix the fan card that disappears after switching selection, let the person rotate a 78-card deck left and right, and animate a drawn card flying out of the deck, flipping to full size and landing in its position. Also add a Face Reading design document and Artifact boards (design only, no code or backend).
successCriteria: Selected topic chips, selected spread tiles and the Council topic chip use the gold selected style already used by Journal, Card library, Inbox and navigation; no pink fill remains for a selected state.
Selecting card A then card B in the fan keeps every card artwork visible; exactly one card shows the raised and gold ring state.
Dragging the fan horizontally (or using the rotate buttons) brings other cards of a 78-card deck into view; cards already drawn leave the deck.

Pressing Turn this card makes the card fly out of the fan, flip face up at large size with its position and name, then fly to its slot; the slot shows the card only after landing. Reveal-all and reduced motion skip the flight.

The floating draw button is a sentence-case pill without the old uppercase style; the old refresh icon and the Change deck link are gone from the draw step; a Random pick link exists as in the design.
Face Reading design document and Artifact boards exist and state consent, 18+, deletion and forbidden inferences.
Mobile typecheck and the full mobile Jest suite pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No backend, Supabase, Edge Function, prompt or data-shape change; the drawn card is still chosen by app logic exactly as before.
Tarot result screen, card guide, deck selection and library are not redesigned in this change.
New spreads from the Artifact (Love 3 cards, 4-card crossroads) are not added here because they change spread data and the AI contract.
No Face Reading code, storage, upload, permission or backend; design only.

managerTestPath: Open Explore > Tarot: selected topic and spread are gold. Press Start drawing, tap one card then another: both stay visible. Swipe the fan sideways to see more cards. Press Turn this card: the card flies out, flips, shows its name, then lands in its slot. Check on a real Android phone.
residualRisk: The disappearing-card bug did not reproduce in the Expo web preview, so the fix is structural (stable layout, no overflow clipping) and must be confirmed on a real Android device. Animation timing is judged by eye on the web preview only.
